Aishwarya Rai Bachchan shares an exceptionally close bond with her mother, Vrinda Rai, who has been a constant pillar of support throughout her career—from her 1994 Miss World victory to her global success today. 
Vrinda Rai is frequently seen accompanying Aishwarya to major international events, including the Cannes Film Festival and various award ceremonies.Professional Collaboration: Beyond her role as a mother, Vrinda co-wrote the story for Aishwarya's 2003 film Dil Ka Rishta.
 Aishwarya often shares heartfelt tributes on social media for her mother's birthday and her parents' wedding anniversaries, frequently featuring her daughter, Aaradhya.
Despite rumors of family tension, Aishwarya continues to visit her mother regularly. Neighbor and filmmaker Prahlad Kakar recently clarified that she often spends time at her mother's house during the week while her daughter is at school.
Three Generations: Public appearances often feature "three generations" of the family together: Vrinda, Aishwarya, and Aaradhya.
Aishwarya Rai Bachchan has been a dedicated Global Goodwill Ambassador for Smile Train since 2009, frequently involving her family in the charity's mission to provide free cleft surgeries. She has often been photographed alongside her mother, Vrinda Rai, and her daughter, Aaradhya, at Smile Train functions, particularly during the annual "Day of Smiles" celebrations.
Aishwarya, accompanied by her husband Abhishek Bachchan and mother Vrinda Rai, attended to support Aaradhya.Aaradhya’s Performance: Aaradhya performed in a musical drama, wearing a black gown and displaying confidence on stage.

items.caption:
The V7 X was built to handle a broad range of instruments, but its versatility starts with what’s inside.

Its custom-tuned DMC7 X dynamic capsule is designed specifically for instruments, pairing smooth, balanced highs with a powerful low-frequency response for a detailed, natural sound.

Add a supercardioid pickup pattern for strong isolation and high gain before feedback, plus an integrated capsule suspension to help reduce handling noise and vibration, and you’ve got a mic built for demanding applications in the studio and on stage.

Powerful. Natural. Focused.

**Some motorcycles are built to impress. The Moto Guzzi V7 was built to endure.**

For more than 50 years, the V7 has been at the heart of Moto Guzzi. It isn't about chasing horsepower figures or the latest trends—it's about creating an authentic motorcycle that delivers character every time you throw a leg over it.

The V7 Stone is the modern expression of that philosophy. Clean, minimalist styling meets timeless Italian engineering, powered by Moto Guzzi's unmistakable **853cc transverse 90° V-twin**. Every twist of the throttle reminds you that this is something different.

With strong low and mid-range torque, a low 780mm seat height, shaft drive and a relaxed upright riding position, the V7 Stone is equally at home weaving through city streets, cruising coastal roads or escaping for a weekend away. Modern technology like ride-by-wire, cruise control, traction control, ABS and LED lighting blend seamlessly into the classic design without taking away from its soul.

**Key Features**
• 853cc air-cooled transverse V-twin
• 67 hp and 79 Nm of torque
• Smooth 6-speed gearbox
• Maintenance-friendly shaft drive
• Ride-by-wire throttle
• Cruise control
• Traction control & ABS
• Full LED lighting with signature eagle DRL
• Cast alloy wheels
• 21-litre fuel tank for serious touring range

The V7 isn't trying to be the fastest bike on the road.

It's trying to be the one you'll still want to ride in 20 years' time.

**If you could take a Moto Guzzi V7 anywhere in New Zealand for a weekend ride, where would you point it first?**

items.caption:
“ever dream this man?” was a campaign created in 2008 to spread awareness of a mysterious figure appearing in people’s dreams around the world.

the story goes that a psychiatric patient drew the face of a man who kept showing up in her dreams and giving her advice about her private life… and then countless other patients recognized the man from their own dreams.

a website called “this man” blew up throughout the late 2000s as fliers were shared on forums like 4chan, alongside tweets from people saying they were afraid of the image being real.

after more than two years of theories, the original creator, sociologist andrea natella, revealed that he had fabricated the whole story and based the sketch of this man on a photo of his father when he was young.

V7 runs 22 hours. The people who make it to the end train for it.

@dayotoldyouso_ of The Group Collective says the real ones keep late days before the V-Series so they have the energy to last.

That is the part nobody mentions about a festival this long. You cannot book your way to one. 26 DJs on a beach is half of it. The other half is a crowd that can take it.

So we asked him how that gets built. Almost none of his answer was about production. “Culture isn’t something you can just manufacture and hand over. When people feel ownership of the floor, they protect the vibe.”

Six editions in, he still won’t name a ceiling. “How long can we go? I guess we’ll never know.”

Swipe for the rest, in his words. ➡️

items.caption: Stirred up more emotions with 7B=~v7 than with data centers and mass surveillance but hey that’s how it goes amirite? And we wonder how we get where we do lol. Anyhoo, couple guide rails that I’ve found useful: an old zen tale goes something like ya start to study zen, and mountains and rivers are mountains and rivers. You get into it, and mountains are no longer mountains, nor are rivers. You grasp the mess, and once again, mountains and rivers are just themselves again. Really, it’s best to not get too caught up in the microanalysis of multinational numerical systems applied to movement on rocks… especially if you haven’t got time in both areas being compared. If it makes anyone feel any better, I can’t climb number ones for squat and I’ve failed on em on all types of rock all over. Just some food for thought.
items.firstComment: Grade compression from decades of history - back when the highest grade given was 6a, explains why you can get scared on a 4+ in Font 😂 which is kinda like my gym’s sandbagged woodie, when most people setting climb in the 6’s and getting up a board 7 is a pipe dream, everything above 6a could be … whatever our fragile ego thinks it is

latestComments.text: Grade compression from decades of history - back when the highest grade given was 6a, explains why you can get scared on a 4+ in Font 😂 which is kinda like my gym’s sandbagged woodie, when most people setting climb in the 6’s and getting up a board 7 is a pipe dream, everything above 6a could be … whatever our fragile ego thinks it is
🤷 You just get different points when playing rock games in different places. They’re a bit frenchier, so they don’t really compare.
And this is a hill I'm camped on. V7 is 7B ~~ even if I really want to tick it as a V8!

🐝 Seven bees is a swarm. Two swarms to a hive. The hive mind thinks the plus is easy and a negative is hard. Give both a tug and see what it feels like. In the forest the waters always warm, and the bubbles always poppin’. A one armed rabbit could swim up stream to the beaver dens, but if you leave it in the sun too long it all falls apart 🐇

“Before I learned the art, a punch was just a punch, and a kick, just a kick. After I learned the art, a punch was no longer a punch, a kick, no longer a kick. Now that I understand the art, a punch is just a punch and a kick is just a kick.” -🐉
Two grades exist in climbing rocks: Path or Desperate.

I've always thought that the plus graded alphanumerals are legitimately just supposed to represent a smaller fraction that happen to be on the higher end. Like 7A+ is just a harder version of 7A, it isn't a totally separate grade. The v grades get it right for v3-5, but it rewards stronger climbers who make quicker gains past v6. Hopefully that makes sense. It probably doesn't.
v2 in my gym either way

Thing is dude, so does 7A a lot of the time haha

since it’s a “next number up” grade in F system
Maybe we can use those data centers and mass surveillance tools to really nail those grades down so we finally get „objective grades“… wouldn’t that be amazing?!

This misunderstanding led me to a very annoying argument with an app developer who, thinking that 7B = V8, was completely certain that therefore 7B+ = V9 and 7C = V10, which was the grading equivalency they used in their app.  He of course refused to budge on that point 🙄
But isn’t that the way they say it goes?

items.caption:
The menu at An’s Dry Cleaning:

Lustring (v)
Orange | Carrot | Ginger | Mint
Lustring is a delicate vegan sorbet comprised of orange and carrot with hints of mint & ginger.

Jusi
Ube | Black Sesame
Our ube gelato base with 8lbs of ube per batch. Then we toast black sesame on the stove, combining that with coconut oil and sugar in the food processor until fluid and smooth. That gets combined with melted cocoa butter, vanilla, salt, and more sugar. Our black sesame swirl is then mixed into the gelato, where it hardens into little chunks.

Moyozashi (NEW)
Hojicha | Cherry | Dark Chocolate
A hojicha forward gelato base made with hojicha from Paru Tea. We make cherry jam using fresh tart cherries that we cook with sugar and lemon juice until the cherries have broken down. Last we mix the cherry jam and 70% dark chocolate into the hojicha gelato base.

Hampton (NEW)
Dark Chocolate | White Chocolate | Butter Cookie
Inspired by the famous black and white cookies, which originated on the east coast. We use a chocolate base similar to Cypress, but with more high-fat cocoa, giving the gelato a richer flavor and smoother feel. Of course we add in white chocolate and butter cookies that are brightened with a touch of orange zest.

Coppola
Cream | Chocolate Cookies | Nutella
Cookies and cream, the An’s way. We make chocolate cookies in-house, crush them up, and add them to our cream gelato. Oh yeah, we also add Nutella.

Pienfu
Oolong | Butterscotch Peanut Butter
A creamy gelato made with Winter Candy oolong from Paru Tea, and an in-house made butterscotch peanut butter.

Fleece
Mango | Saffron | Greek Yogurt
A tangy, creamy gelato that is perfectly balanced.

#gelato

items.caption:
افاتار مبقتش افاتار ولا ايه؟ 

في الحياة ساعات بتكون مميز عشان عندك شخصية مختلفة عن كل اللي حواليك

المشكلة بتبدء لما تلاقي السوق كله رايح في اتجاه معين فتقول طب ما اجرب العب معاهم بنفس اللعبة

دي AVATR T09 الجديدة 👀

العربية ظهرت رسميا في ملفات وزارة الصناعة الصينية MIIT وتصميمها عامل جدل كبير جدا لان افاتار طول عمرها من اكتر الشركات الصينية اللي عندها شخصية وتصميم تعرفه من بعيد

لكن الـ T09 الجديدة مختلفة تماما الموضوع مخلصش لحد هنا يا ابو الصحاب اصبر بس اخبط الايك الجميل بتاعك وتعالى 🥰

العربية دي افاتار عايزة تدخل بيها الشرق الاوسط 

افاتار قالت بدل ما اسيب سوق العربيات البوكسي الكبيرة ل Yangwang واللي شبها وباقي المنافسين ادخل انا كمان وسط الماسورة 😂

خصوصا ان الشركة عندها توسع ومهتمة بلشرق الاوسط

AVATR T09 عربية SUV ضخمة بـ 6 مقاعد

الطول 5285 مم . العرض 2025 مم . الارتفاع لحد 1820 مم . وقاعدة العجلات 3150 مم

يعني احنا بنتكلم عن عربية اكبر من 5.2 متر ووزنها في بعض النسخ بيعدي 3 طن 😳

والجامد ان البطارية 71.24 كيلو وات من CATL 🔋وده رقم ضخم جدا بالنسبة لعربية PHEV

النسخة الاولى بمحرك بنزين 1.5 لتر ومعاه موتورين كهربا

موتور امامي 180 كيلو وات وموتور خلفي 310 كيلو وات بتوصل ل 657 حصان 

اما النسخة التانية فهنا الموضوع بيقلب جنان 😂😂

موتور بنزين 2.0 لتر و3 مواتير كهربا 180 كيلو وات قدام 225 كيلو وات ورا يمين 225 كيلو وات ورا شمال

يعني قدرة المواتير الكهربا حوالي 630 كيلو وات 845 حصان 

لكن القصة الاهم عندي مش الـ 845 حصان

القصة ان افاتار ممكن تكون وصلت لنقطة بتسأل نفسها افضل محافظة على شخصيتي المختلفة

ولا ادخل وسط ماسورة الـ SUV البوكسي اللي السوق خصوصا في الشرق الاوسط بقى بيحبها جدا؟

وانا هنا مش بقول ان افاتار قلدت حد

لكن واضح ان لغة التصميم في T09 مختلفة جدا عن اللي فات

هل شايفين افاتار صح انها تدخل لعبة العربيات البوكسي الضخمة؟

ولو العربية نزلت الشرق الاوسط بالسعر الصح تقدر تنافس الـ Yangwang U8 وباقي الوحوش دي؟

ولا كنتوا تفضلوا افاتار تفضل محافظة على شخصيتها القديمة؟

اما المصادر اللي اعتمدت عليها هتلاقيها في اول كومنت وهتلاقي كمان صور القمر دي 🥰 

فين بحبك يا ابو ابصحاب قفشتك 😂

ودلوقتي هتلاقي الفيس بوك كله بيتكلم عليها 😂

items.caption:
For Sale — Moto Guzzi V7 Sport (1973)

Moto Guzzi V7 Sport is often regarded as one of the definitive expressions of the marque.

Introduced in 1971, the V7 Sport transformed the practical V7 platform into a true sporting motorcycle. Its lightweight frame, low-slung stance, and iconic transverse 90-degree V-twin engine established a formula that would later lead to the legendary Le Mans.

Widely considered one of the most beautiful Moto Guzzis ever built, the V7 Sport remains a landmark model in the history of Italian motorcycling.

In Porsche terms, it may be compared to a late 911 Carrera 3.2. Not the most flamboyant model in the range, but one that those who truly understand the marque eventually come to appreciate and aspire to own.

For many enthusiasts, this is the Moto Guzzi to own.

For inquiries, please contact us via DM or through the link in our profile.

⸻

販売車両のご案内 — Moto Guzzi V7 Sport（1973）

Moto Guzziを愛する人々にとって、一つの到達点とも言える存在です。

1971年に登場したV7 Sportは、それまでの実用的なツアラーとしてのV7をベースに、スポーツモデルとして再構築された特別な一台でした。

軽量化されたフレーム、低く構えたスタイリング、そしてMoto Guzziの象徴である横置き90°Vツイン。後のLe Mansへと続く系譜の原点であり、多くの愛好家から「最も美しいMoto Guzzi」と評されるモデルでもあります。

Porscheでいえば911 Carrera 3.2の後期モデルに通じる存在かもしれません。決して派手なモデルではありませんが、その魅力を知る人ほどわかる、一度は手元に置いておきたい一台です。

For many enthusiasts, this is the Moto Guzzi to own.

お問い合わせはDMまたはプロフィールリンクよりお気軽にご連絡ください。

items.caption:
#EatsArchive: Born out of a standoff with international soft drink manufacturers during Nasser’s era, when rising import costs and failed negotiations pushed Egypt to cut ties and produce its own soft drinks, Masr Cola emerged in the late 1950s as part of a wave of homegrown fizzy alternatives that filled the gap.

The slogan says it plainly: “Everyone prefers it—authentically Egyptian. Not blonde, not brunette, just Egyptian, and that’s enough.” Priced at just one and a half piastres a bottle.

من سنين كتير وتحديدًا في فترة الخمسينيات، "مصر كولا" كانت هي المشروب الوطني الشعبي للمصريين، أو على الأقل هما قالوا في إعلانهم كده. 

في عهد جمال عبد الناصر، اتولدت "مصر كولا" من قلب صراع مع شركات المشروبات الغازية العالمية، لما تكاليف الاستيراد زادت والمفاوضات فشلت، "عبد الناصر" طلب من مصانعنا توقف إنتاج البيبسي كولا والكوكا كولا، وبدالهم يتم إنتاج مياه غازية مصرية خالصة اسمها "مصر كولا"، وبقرش ونص بس.

قولنا بقى تفتكر لو "مصر كولا" كانت موجودة لحد النهارده، كنت هتتحمس تجربها؟

#Throwback to an unforgettable night in Egypt, where the ancient grandeur of the Pyramids of Giza provided a spectacular backdrop for the launch of the BYD Ti 7 ⚡️

Moments like these are about more than unveiling a new vehicle. They bring together innovation, design, technology, and local culture to create an experience people can truly connect with.

Designed with modern families and adventurers in mind, the BYD Ti 7 offers a spacious 7-seat cabin, an open and comfortable interior, and the versatility to handle whatever life brings along. Whether it's the daily commute, a weekend escape, or a family road trip, there's room for every journey.

Set against one of the world's most iconic landmarks, the launch showcased a bold vision for the future of mobility while creating an unforgettable experience in the heart of Egypt.

Through Ultimate Experiences, guests were given the opportunity to witness a world-class automotive launch in an extraordinary setting where history, innovation, and storytelling came together under the desert sky.

After 12 years… they're finally back.

@dankubin V7.5 Sidewinders are back (again)💥⚡️

One of the biggest advantages of the V7.5 is that stroke length and hit can be adjusted independently.

Stroke length is changed with the Allen key on the side of the machine using indexed reference points, making it easy to switch between settings.

The tension adjustment on the back lets you fine-tune the hit without changing the stroke length. Leave it in the standard position for the classic V7 feel, turn it counterclockwise for a harder hit, or clockwise for a softer, more forgiving touch.

That means you can keep the stroke you like while adjusting how the machine delivers power to suit different needle groupings, skin, and tattooing styles.

A couple of small batches are available now on the Workhorse site, including this beautiful Verdigris × Black finish.

وتأتي السيارة بفئتين تعتمدان على تكنولوجيا المحركات الهجينة بمدى قيادة استثنائي وتجهيزات متقدمة للأمان والراحة.

أسعار فئات هافال V7 في مصر:
• فئة Ultra Hybrid FWD (دفع أمامي): بسعر 1,825,000 جنيه.
• فئة Ultra Plug-In Hybrid AWD (دفع كلي): بسعر 2,100,000 جنيه.

أداء ومواصفات المنظومة الهجينة (محرك 1.5 لتر تيربو):

1. النسخة الهجينة FWD:
• القوة والعزم: 244 حصانًا مع عزم دوران 530 نيوتن متر.
• ناقل الحركة: 2-Speed DHT.
• البطارية والمدى: بطارية LFP بسعة 19.94 كيلووات/ساعة، ومدى قيادة مجمع يصل إلى 1000 كم (وفق دورة NEDC).
2. نسخة Plug-In Hybrid AWD:
• القوة والعزم: قوة إجمالية تصل إلى 469 حصانًا مع عزم أقصى 760 نيوتن متر.
• ناقل الحركة: 4-Speed DHT.
• البطارية والمدى: بطارية LFP بسعة 27.5 كيلووات/ساعة، ومدى قيادة مجمع يصل إلى 1200 كم (وفق دورة NEDC).

الأبعاد والسعة التخزينية:
• الأبعاد: الطول 4800 مم | العرض 1916 مم | الارتفاع 1822 مم | قاعدة العجلات 2738 مم.
• المساحة الخلفية: سعة تخزين بين 369 و1480 لترًا.
• العجلات: جنوط رياضية مقاس 19 بوصة مع إطارات 255/60 R19.

items.caption:
The importance of teaching basic digital literacy 📲

Nowadays, mobile phones are one of the most useful tool for everyday life, especially for migrants, asylum seekers and refugees that arrive in a totaly new country and culture

Thus, we teach very basic but key knowledge to help them to:
💬 Know basic tools for communication (how to write mails, use instant message apps, send documents)
💼 Use phone for job search (formal mail writing, creating and sending CV, formal discussion, use apps for job search)

Because not of all them are aware and used to our tools in Croatia and in Europe, we believe it is vital to be able to properly use and handle it, and that's why we are organizing several digital literacy workshop all over the year!

You can already register for the next one for free:
🗓️ 15/05
🕐 From 13:00 to 17:00

*This activity is financed by @gradzagrebzg and is carried out within the Action Plan of the City of Zagreb for the implementation of the Charter of Integrating Cities

See the Bayeux Tapestry for FREE!

Well not the actual Bayeux Tapestry but a stitch perfect reproduction made by a group of Victorian women.

You can see it for FREE @readingmuseum 

Reading is at the end of the Elizabeth Line, really easy to get to.

I have seen both the original and the Reading version ... you can get much closer at Reading and really see the details.

My recommendation would be to see the Reading version first, to get an idea of the story that the tapestry tells. Then hop on the Elizabeth Line to @britishmuseum to see the real thing

Whilst you'revin Reading be sure note to miss Reading Abbey, burial place of King Heney I, son of William the Conqueror

Você já viu um barco com a frente reta e afiada como uma lâmina? O registro de @yachtsbyed mostra em detalhes o funcionamento da Axe Bow (proa de machado), uma revolução no design naval para navios de apoio e iates de alta performance.

Diferente das proas tradicionais, que tentam subir e passar por cima das ondas, a Axe Bow foi desenhada para cortar a água. Isso traz três vantagens que mudam o jogo no mar:

Conforto e Segurança: Ao “fatiar” a face da onda, o barco balança muito menos (menos pitching e impactos secos), mantendo a navegação estável mesmo em águas agitadas.

Velocidade e Eficiência: O casco se mantém nivelado, o que permite manter a velocidade constante sem precisar desacelerar a todo momento, resultando em economia de
combustivel.

Estabilidade no Convés: Para navios de apoio, isso é vital!
Sem o barco “quicar” na água, o convés se torna uma plataforma firme para lançar botes, jet skis e equipamentos com total segurança. 

É a engenharia naval trabalhando a favor da eficiência e do conforto extremo em alto-mar! 

#mar #navegação #tecnología #navio #viral

The Simpsons are taking over Jack in the Box just in time for Halloween!

Expected to launch around September 18, the new Munchie Meal of Horror is bringing the world of Treehouse of Horror to Jack in the Box with limited-edition food, packaging, and collectibles.

The meal is expected to feature Halloween-themed Monster Tacos, curly fries, a drink, and a special burger or chicken sandwich. There could also be six collectible Simpsons character cups featuring colorful glow-in-the-dark designs.

And of course, they couldn’t forget Homer’s love for doughnuts! A special Forbidden D’oh!nut Holes item is also expected to join the Halloween lineup.

This could be one of Jack in the Box’s biggest Halloween collabs yet.

items.caption:
Foton Tunland V7 Offroad Drive
🐺 @dieterpey 

Today I had the privilege of driving the new Foton Tunland V7 at Grabouw 4x4 during the @foton.unleashed 4x4 day.

We took it through the green route and parts of the orange route, which were fairly washed out, technical, and a proper test for a standard vehicle. Straight off the bat, the V7 impressed me with its capability, comfort, and off-road features.

The interior is spacious, modern, and packed with tech, including a large infotainment screen, digital cluster, automatic gearbox, paddle shifters, and plenty of room for passengers. We had five people in the vehicle, and everyone sat comfortably.

Off-road, the biggest highlight is that it comes standard with front and rear lockers, proper low range, 2H, 4H, 4L, and auto 4x4 modes. The low range is seriously low, almost like a crawl gear, which makes it very controlled on technical sections and steep descents.

Overall, for a stock standard vehicle, the Foton Tunland V7 handled the track surprisingly well and left a strong first impression.

Phlegm Colors and What They Mean Md Suhail 
Your mucus color can give important clues about your health. Clear phlegm is usually normal and may appear with allergies or mild colds. White mucus can indicate nasal congestion or early infection. Yellow phlegm often means your immune system is fighting an infection, while green mucus may suggest a stronger viral or bacterial infection. Brown mucus can result from dust, smoke, or dried blood, and black or gray phlegm may be linked to pollution, smoking, or inhaled particles. Persistent cough, fever, chest pain, or blood in mucus should be checked by a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and treatment.

items.caption:
⚽ MATCH REPORT | WARATAH WPL

 V Bathurst 75’s 
On the road in Bathurst this week to take on Bathurst 75’s who have won both their first two games of the season.

📝 Match Summary
Waratahs put a big emphasis on a good start, looked very dangerous in the first 20 minutes and very unlucky not to take an early lead with Juan Agudelo being denied by the post.  Unfortunately a couple of injuries forced some positional changes, but Waratahs still fought hard and again were unlucky with Jack Pinkstone drawing a good save from the 75’s keeper.

Half time ended as 1-0 to Bathurst 75’s, who were able to steal a goal leading into the break.  Down on troops, Waratahs keep fighting in the second half and while they were able to create a few chances, a 60th minute goal to 75’s, along with another in the dying minutes saw the final score as 3-0

💬 Coach’s Comments
“Definitely not the result we were after and while we are disappointed not getting a result, heaps of positives to take out of the game, and really keen to build on this next week.”

👏 Special Mentions
Waratahs WPL debut for Lachlan Fogarty, who keep chasing and pressuring throughout the game.  Also first game of the season for Darcy Kelly, who was very solid at left back and welcome addition back into the team with a great amount of positive talk.

✨ PŘEDSTAVUJEME VÁM ELIŠKU ✨

Naši novou Pilates instruktorku, která do Orange Gym přinese lekce zaměřené na vědomý pohyb, sílu, stabilitu a dobrý pocit ze sebe sama. 🧡

Eliška se pohybu věnuje už od dětství — několik let závodně krasobruslila a věnovala se také aerobiku. Po delší pauze od sportu si ale znovu začala budovat vztah k pohybu i vlastnímu tělu a právě tehdy objevila pilates.

„K pilatesu jsem se naplno dostala po druhém porodu, kdy jsem hledala způsob, jak své tělo zpevnit, posílit a znovu se ve svém těle cítit dobře. Pilates mě oslovil tím, že není jen o výkonu, ale hlavně o vědomém pohybu, správném držení těla, síle a celkové rovnováze.“ ✨

Absolvovala kurz instruktora pilates a v září ji čeká další vzdělávání v rámci kurzu funkčního trenéra se zaměřením na ženy. Ve svých lekcích chce vytvářet příjemné a podporující prostředí, kde se každý může cítit dobře bez ohledu na věk, zkušenosti nebo aktuální kondici. 🤍

items.caption:
LinkedIn ako nástroj, ktorý pracuje pre vás.

Na workshope, ktorý si pre študentov programu Future Founders Varsity pripravila world class LinkedIn expertka Ivana Brutenic, PhD zo SUNDAYFLIES sme sa nebavili o tom, ako nazbierať čo najviac lajkov.

Učili sme sa ako z LinkedInu spraviť nástroj na budovanie dôvery, príležitostí a budúcich klientov.
Mnohí študenti vnímajú LinkedIn ako niečo, čo budú riešiť „až keď si budú hľadať prácu“. Realita je však iná.

LinkedIn je dnes miesto, kde:
 → vznikajú obchodné príležitosti
 → hľadajú sa partneri a mentori
 → firmy objavujú talenty
 → buduje sa osobná značka ešte skôr, ako ju budete potrebovať

Venovali sme sa aj tomu, ako funguje nový LinkedIn algoritmus.

Dobrá správa? Čoraz menej rozhoduje počet followerov.
Oveľa viac rozhoduje:
 ✔️ relevancia obsahu
 ✔️ kvalita interakcií
 ✔️ odbornosť v konkrétnej téme
 ✔️ schopnosť prinášať hodnotu svojej komunite

Pre začínajúcich founderov je to veľká príležitosť. Nemusia súťažiť s ľuďmi, ktorí sú na platforme 10 rokov. Stačí konzistentne zdieľať skúsenosti, postrehy z budovania projektu, úspechy aj slepé uličky.

Najzaujímavejšia myšlienka z workshopu?
Ľudia nekupujú od profilov. Kupujú od ľudí, ktorým dôverujú.
A LinkedIn je dnes jeden z najefektívnejších nástrojov, ako si túto dôveru budovať dlhodobo.

Ďakujeme Ivanka, za neskutočne informáciami nabitý workshop, energiu a ochotu podeliť sa o svoje know- how.

items.caption:
🔍 ¿Amígdalas normales o infectadas?

Las amígdalas pueden cambiar mucho cuando hay una infección.
Pero algo muy importante: no todas las amigdalitis son iguales… y reconocer la diferencia puede cambiar completamente el tratamiento.

⸻

🟢 AMÍGDALA NORMAL

• Tamaño pequeño y simétrico
• Color rosado uniforme
• Sin inflamación
• Sin placas ni secreción
• Deglución normal, sin dolor

👉 Sensación: garganta limpia, sin molestias

⸻

🔴 AMIGDALITIS (INFECCIÓN BACTERIANA)

• Aumento de tamaño (amígdalas inflamadas)
• Enrojecimiento intenso
• Presencia de placas blancas o amarillas (pus)
• Dolor al tragar (odinofagia)
• Fiebre y malestar general

👉 Sensación: dolor importante y dificultad para tragar

⸻

⚠️ IMPORTANTE

No todas las infecciones de garganta son bacterianas.
Muchas son virales y no requieren antibióticos.

👉 Por eso es clave una valoración adecuada:
para evitar tratamientos innecesarios y usar el medicamento correcto cuando sí se necesita.

⸻

📩 Si tienes alguna duda o crees que presentas estos síntomas, envíame un mensaje.

Dr.  Juan Pablo De La Vega, otorrinolaringólogo y cirujano de cabeza y cuello

⸻

#amigdalas #amigdalitis #garganta #otorrinolaringologo #infeccion

El cáncer de amígdalas es un tipo de cáncer de cabeza y cuello que se origina en las amígdalas palatinas, ubicadas a ambos lados de la parte posterior de la boca. La mayoría de los cánceres de amígdalas son carcinomas de células escamosas que surgen de la mucosa oral. En muchos países, un número creciente de casos se relaciona con el virus del papiloma humano (VPH), en particular el VPH-16, también se relaciona con el consumo excesivo de alcohol y tabaco.

En muchos casos, es diagnosticado en estadios avanzados, cuando se ha extendido a otras zonas.

La buena noticia es que este tipo de cáncer es altamente tratable. Con un diagnóstico temprano y atención multidisciplinaria experta, muchas personas se curan, conservando la deglución, el habla y la apariencia. 

Las claves son, la prevención con chequeos médicos y odontológicos regulares, mantener una buena higiene bucal, evitar consumo de alcohol y tabaco, vacuna contra el VPH.

Acude a consulta ORL para una valoración médica especializada.

items.caption:
The “TOLBA” is a beautiful Arab tradition, where the groom’s family asks the bride’s family for her hand in marriage. 

It’s a tradition that signifies union… 
Not only between the couples but between the families as well. 
Family in the Arab world is so huge and I always heard growing up, that the moment you marry someone, you marry into their family too. 

In the moment that this happened, where the uncles spoke, when my father in law spoke I felt so honored, seen, and protected. I felt both families truly uniting in love and respect. I absolutely love when my mama and his mama shared too. It was incredibly important to me that the women of the family SPEAK as well. They raised us, I am grateful for my uncles, his family, mine, and everyone who was a part of this. 

With gratitude I thank you all again, and pray for you and us allllll the time 🤲🏼❤️

All the love and union to all 🤍
Marriage is sacred, and I am feeling deeply more why that is, every single, day. 

Hamdilah الحمدلله 

#tolba #marriage #arab #tradition #love

Der Grünen-Co-Vorsitzende Felix Banaszak fordert im ZDF-Sommerinterview, die Energiewende schneller voranzutreiben. "Wir brauchen die Energiewende auch dafür, dass am Ende der Strom für die Leute günstiger wird", sagt er. 

Banaszak findet auch: Es sei richtig, dass die Grünen Klima und Energiepolitik in den Fokus ihrer Politik stellen. "Das ist das eine Thema, wo man ja wirklich befürchten muss, wenn die Grünen es nicht mehr bearbeiten, dann macht es am Ende niemand mehr", sagt er. Gerade angesichts der Hitze und Dürre, würde er sich einen politischen Wettbewerb darum wünschen, "wer die beste Klimapolitik" macht. 

Zu den bevorstehenden Wahlen in Sachsen-Anhalt, Berlin und Mecklenburg-Vorpommern sagte Banaszak: "Ich schließe vor einer Wahl im demokratischen Spektrum grundsätzlich keine Koalition aus." In einer Situation, in der man befürchten müsse, dass "Antidemokraten und Verfassungsfeinde Einfluss auf die Politik bekommen", müssten Demokraten miteinander gesprächsfähig sein, forderte der Grünen-Chef. 

#Banaszak #Sommerinterview #Aktuelles #ZDFheute

2 Minuten - 34g Protein Mangoshake! Perfekt nach dem Workout.

Das Protein im Skyr ist hochwertig, leicht verdaulich und hilft dabei, die Muskelfasern zu reparieren und aufzubauen. Gleichzeitig hält es lange satt.

Mango liefert nach dem Training schnell verfügbare Kohlenhydrate, die die Energiespeicher wieder auffüllen und die Regeneration unterstützen. 
Zusätzlich steigt das Insulin an, was den Transport des Proteins in die Muskulatur unterstützt! 

Kokosraspeln liefern gesunde Fette, sorgen für mehr Geschmack und helfen, den Shake sättigender zu machen.

150g Mango (gefroren oder frisch)
300g Skyr
10g Kokosraspeln
150ml Wasser

Alle Zutaten in einen Mixbecher geben und gut mixen. Fertig!

343 kcal / 34g P / 32g KH / 7g F

items.alt: Video by Kora Plus on April 27, 2026.

items.caption:
Helicóptero desaparecido - O empresário Bruno Avelar, que está com o cantor Rick, da dupla Rick e Renner, no helicóptero que desapareceu nesta segunda-feira (21), em Santa Catarina, publicou nas redes sociais imagens do início da viagem.

No vídeo, publicado nos stories do Instagram antes da viagem, Bruno aparece ainda em casa e mostra um pequeno boneco de massinha que diz pertencer ao filho mais novo. Ele desenha um rosto no brinquedo e conta que pretende deixar o boneco para a criança.

“Peguei um bonequinho de massinha do meu filho mais novo. Vou deixar aqui um recadinho para ele no boneco dele. Fiz uma carinha, acho que ele vai curtir”, diz.

Na sequência, Bruno fala sobre os compromissos que teria naquele dia e afirma que iria a Balneário Camboriú e Criciúma para encontrar amigos e visitar empresas.

As imagens mostram depois o empresário saindo de casa de carro e chegando a um local onde está estacionada uma aeronave de pequeno porte. Bruno encontra Rick no local e cumprimenta o cantor.

O registro foi feito antes do deslocamento para Santa Catarina. Segundo as informações divulgadas pelas autoridades, o helicóptero que posteriormente perdeu comunicação decolou de Porto Belo, no Litoral Norte catarinense, e tinha São Joaquim como destino.

Além de Bruno e Rick, estavam no helicóptero um videomaker e o piloto, segundo a assessoria do cantor.

items.caption:
ALERTA IMPORTANTE | VERMES EM CRIANÇAS: VOCÊ PRECISA SABER DISSO 🚨👶

Uma semana. Três vermes. E um susto enorme.

Essa mãe percebeu que algo não estava certo: noites mal dormidas, irritação e um comportamento diferente do normal 😟
Até que veio a confirmação… a criança eliminou três vermes em poucos dias.

E a verdade é que isso é mais comum do que parece.

As parasitoses intestinais afetam principalmente crianças, já que elas têm mais contato com o chão, objetos contaminados e ainda estão desenvolvendo hábitos de higiene 🦠

Fique atento aos sinais:
• Barriga inchada
• Coceira na região anal (principalmente à noite)
• Irritabilidade e cansaço
• Alterações no sono
• Falta de apetite ou emagrecimento

Como prevenir:
• Lavar bem as mãos (principalmente antes de comer e após usar o banheiro) 🧼
• Manter unhas curtas e limpas
• Higienizar alimentos corretamente
• Evitar andar descalço em locais sujos
• Manter roupas íntimas e de cama sempre limpas

Importante: nada de automedicação! O tratamento correto depende do tipo de verme e deve ser orientado por um profissional 👨‍⚕️

Isso não é pra gerar pânico… é pra gerar consciência.

Se você tem criança em casa, observe mais de perto. Saúde não é achismo, é cuidado.

Pra entender mais, corre nos stories de hoje 👀
